data.one_liner: Platform agnostic gettext localization framework for Dart and Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart implementation of the gettext localization framework, ported from node-gettext. It supports domains, contexts, and plurals with built-in plural forms for 136 languages, allowing you to change locale or domain on the fly.
use_when: You need to localize your Dart or Flutter application using standard gettext files (.json, .po, .mo).
You require dynamic locale and domain switching at runtime.
You need robust pluralization rules across many languages.
avoid_when: You prefer compile-time safe localization with code generation.
You rely entirely on the official Flutter intl package ecosystem.
strengths: Supports domains, contexts, and plurals out of the box.
Ships with plural forms for 136 languages.
Platform agnostic implementation that also works with Flutter.
weaknesses: Relies on manual translation loading and parsing rather than generated type-safe keys.
Requires external packages like gettext_parser to parse standard .po or .mo files.

alternatives.name: intl
alternatives.why_pick_it: Standard localization library provided by the Dart team with built-in date, number, and message formatting.

alternatives.name: slang
alternatives.why_pick_it: Type-safe localization through code generation instead of dynamic runtime keys.

alternatives.name: easy_localization
alternatives.why_pick_it: Easy-to-use JSON/YAML localization for Flutter with built-in widget extensions.
